comment: A42 C-first mission for trap.c:trapeffect_anti_magic's hero branch. A fresh Healer with ordinary magic energy and no antimagical equipment leaves the upstairs square, wishes an anti-magic field onto ordinary floor, steps away, then triggers it. Observe the source energy-drain path and updated Pw status; this is distinct from physical trap impacts or monster-triggered traps. The C terrain-wish name is the cmap explanation `anti-magic field` (defsym.c), not “anti magic trap.”
